name: Total Apps World Profit Studio Basic for WooCommerce
author: Dennis Gouzoulis

sections.description:
Turn WooCommerce sales data into clear profit insights.

Total Apps World Profit Studio Basic gives WooCommerce store owners a clear view of sales, revenue, product costs, gross profit and margins from one easy-to-use dashboard.

Stop relying only on turnover. See what your products are actually contributing to your business, identify your most profitable items, monitor customers and stock, and export the data you need for further analysis.

Key features include:

  • Sales and revenue dashboard
  • Orders and refunds overview
  • Product cost tracking
  • Gross profit and gross margin calculations
  • Product profitability analysis
  • Customer insights
  • Stock and inventory overview
  • Flexible date filters
  • Sales and profit charts
  • CSV, XLSX and PDF exports
  • Native WooCommerce integration

Built for store owners who want useful numbers without unnecessary complexity.

Profit Studio Basic runs directly inside WordPress and uses your existing WooCommerce data.

Why Profit Studio Basic?

WooCommerce tells you how much you sold. Profit Studio Basic helps you understand what those sales actually mean.

Track product costs alongside sales, compare profitability across products and periods, and get a clearer picture of how your store is performing — without spreadsheets or external analytics platforms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/total-apps-world-profit-studio-basic-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Total Apps World Profit Studio in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce is declared as a required plugin.

Does Profit Studio Basic track product costs?

Yes. You can define product costs and use them to calculate gross profit and gross margin.

Can I see which products are most profitable?

Yes. Product profitability reports show sales, costs, gross profit and margins by product.

Can I export my reports?

Yes. Profit Studio Basic includes CSV, XLSX and PDF export options.

Does the plugin send my store data to an external service?

No. Profit Studio Basic performs its reporting inside your WordPress installation and does not require a licensing or analytics service to use its included features.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Profit Studio Pro adds deeper business profitability tools such as operating costs, advertising costs, taxes, Profit & Loss reporting and advanced analytics.
